_comment: Shipped inside every zh-game-<tag>.zip (package.ps1 copies config\* into the game root). The launcher reads it after updating, so changing these here and releasing updates both machines; nothing to resend. Per-machine settings stay in launcher.json.
_Options_note: Written into each machine's Options.ini before every launch (launcher.json OptionsOverride wins per machine). Upstream's 'VeryHigh' detail preset values; DynamicLOD off so detail does not pop under load; ArchiveReplays feeds verify.ps1 baselines. Resolution, volumes, Gamma etc. are left to the player.
_LanPeers_note: Tailnet IPs of both machines (vision-1, admiral). The launcher passes each as -lanpeer so the LAN lobby unicasts its announcements/scans to them; a tailnet carries no broadcasts, which is why Direct Connect was needed before.
